title: White House reportedly names DNI Jay Clayton acting national cyber director while nominee Kirsten Davies awaits Senate confirmation
date_note: Page dates the order to 23 November (US time), citing CNBC.
org: White House / Office of the Director of National Intelligence
summary: Cybersecurity Dive, citing an anonymous White House official and a statement from Jay Clayton, reports that the Director of National Intelligence will temporarily serve as national cyber director. Pentagon CIO Kirsten Davies, first named acting director, was instead chosen for the permanent job and awaits Senate confirmation. Fnnews, relaying CNBC, reports the same interim arrangement.
plain: Cybersecurity Dive reports that intelligence chief Jay Clayton will temporarily serve as US national cyber director while nominee Kirsten Davies awaits Senate confirmation.
exec: Cybersecurity Dive and Fnnews report an interim change in who leads US cyber policy, according to a White House official.

validation.note: Cybersecurity Dive (anonymous White House official plus a Clayton statement) and Fnnews (relaying CNBC) both report the interim role; no on-record White House release was read.

review.note: Compared date, interim role, Davies status, attribution against Cybersecurity Dive and Fnnews (relaying CNBC)
